summary: Independent static review of the updated Release Intelligence v2.0.0-GA GOLDEN BUILD ZIP SHA256 0e6f673b42ce842044cad2827c6d144b9625193259e67ea89a99d6771460642d. All 28 packaged files byte-match source. The monthly-updates tile now selects epics awaiting the review-month update, using the same draft-first, trimmed monthly text criterion as its existing update count. The active filter has a removable label, participates in existing Clear/Escape handling, and follows review-month changes. No new fetch, model, or write path is introduced. No blocking issues found. Overall application risk remains High under the existing rubric assessment.
caveats: As with the existing metric, a nonempty saved draft counts as an update even before GUS publication; an explicitly empty draft is treated as awaiting an update. Undated general comments do not count as a dated monthly update.

Claim checks are strict linguistic heuristics, not a proof of factual grounding or complete coverage. They can reject valid paraphrases and cannot exhaust every misleading formulation; source fallbacks and human review remain necessary. Goals, Closed status, review readiness, release, deployment, and production must remain distinct.

Chronological ordering changes section positions during explicit monthly writes. Ambiguous years and rich markup that cannot be safely reconstructed fail closed with the draft retained; arbitrary HTML structures are not guaranteed to reorder successfully.

Slack Nudge prepares a reminder only. It does not send a DM. Recipient matching requires the optional host resolveIdentity capability; otherwise users must copy the message and choose the Development Lead in Slack. User review is required before manual sending.
Current GUS Apps host metadata still relies on verified-definition snapshots; automatic future list-column detection remains unavailable without live list-view REST capability.

Existing usage completeness, preview cache/cancellation, popup accessibility/scroll, refresh concurrency, journal growth, revision conflicts, non-atomic updates, preference semantics, host/catalog/history limits, and AllUsers sharing caveats remain.

This was a static source/artifact review. The implementing agent reported the GA-controls browser regression passed, including missing-update filtering, Clear, and Escape, and Node syntax validation passed. These checks and production-host behavior were not independently executed; the prior full-suite results remain inherited.
